title: On The Robustness-Resolution Tradeoff In Temporal Quantization Of Event Streams
abstract: arXiv:2609.22295v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event pipelines often discretize asynchronous timestamps before learning. This step looks harmless, but its stability depends directly on temporal resolution. We study this dependence at the representation level. We first show that hard temporal binning is discontinuous: an arbitrarily small timestamp shift near a boundary can move unit event mass between bins. We then define a class of nonnegative, mass-preserving, resolution-faithful continuous encoders and prove that every encoder in this class has global L1 sensitivity at least 2/Delta, where Delta denotes bin width. Linear two-bin interpolation attains this limit. Local support and first-moment preservation also make it unique. Experiments on SHD, N-MNIST, and DVS128 Gesture support the analysis. translated_title: 论事件流时间量化中的鲁棒性-分辨率权衡
translated_abstract: 事件流水线通常在学习之前对异步时间戳进行离散化。这一步骤看似无害，但其稳定性直接取决于时间分辨率。我们在表示层面研究这种依赖关系。我们首先证明硬时间分箱是不连续的：边界附近的任意微小时间戳偏移都可能使单位事件质量在分箱之间移动。随后我们定义了一类非负、质量保持、分辨率忠实的连续编码器，并证明该类中的每个编码器都具有至少 2/Δ 的全局 L1 敏感度，其中 Δ 表示分箱宽度。线性两分箱插值达到了这一极限，而局部支撑与一阶矩保持也使其成为唯一达到该极限的编码器。在 SHD、N-MNIST 和 DVS128 Gesture 数据集上的实验支持了这一分析。在统一的时间戳预算下，线性插值将平均表示漂移降低了 47-72%，同时保持干净准确率几乎不变。在 DVS Gesture 上，它产生零预测（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示了事件流时间量化中硬分箱的不连续性，证明了一类质量保持的连续编码器的全局 L1 敏感度下界为 2/Δ，且线性两分箱插值达到该理论极限，实验中可将表示漂移降低 47-72% 而不损失准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the discontinuity of hard temporal binning in event stream quantization, proves a global L1 sensitivity lower bound of 2/Δ for a class of mass-preserving continuous encoders, and shows that linear two-bin interpolation attains this theoretical limit, reducing representation drift by 47-72% in experiments without sacrificing accuracy.
